body:
Build 4.2-rebuild executed against docs/pre-registration-geopn-kc.md (sealed R1, PR #9). KC/MBON machinery byte-identical to the failed v0 run; only the PN encoding changed (64-dim geometric, QR-orthonormal prototypes seed 20261001, rho=tan30 cones).

Honest FAIL, no goalpost move:
- G1 orthonormal PASS (7.8e-16), G3 within-between +0.7998 PASS, **G2 FAIL — spec bug**: analytic worst-case deviation for normalize(u+rho*eps) at rho=tan(30deg) is arcsin(rho)=35.26deg, not the spec's claimed 30deg; measured 33.76deg is inside the true bound. Recorded, not patched.
- H1 0.88 < 0.90 (dense null 0.26) FAIL; H2 0.448 < router 0.931 FAIL; H3 interference 41.2-pt drop FAIL; H4 shuffle 0.76 discriminating but > 0.40 ceiling FAIL.
- Encodes did beat dense nulls everywhere (class-locality mechanism real, magnitude insufficient). Zero-hit path identical to v0 (5/50); locality 102 rows; decision chain fnv1a-64 81a0674dba58b705.

Stacked on #9. Main untouched.
title: kc_geo: geometric-PN KC layer RUN vs sealed spec (R1) — FAIL, receipted
